name: Roman Two-Tone Capitals
description: Tall condensed Roman inscriptional capitals on parchment, with the title split into two words of contrasting colour — ink black over deep red.
phrase: tall narrow classical Roman inscriptional capitals of the kind cut into imperial stone, sharp triangular serifs and swelling stems with a chiselled entasis, set on aged parchment with thin even tracking, the title split across two words that carry contrasting colour — the first in dense ink black and the second in a deep oxide red — both flat and matte with no glow, no outline and no drop shadow
